drafts.walkScript: Start with finish. Find the word that could swap places with it. Complete means the same as finish, so complete fits. Begin is its opposite. Win and race can come with a finish, but neither means finish.
Start with fast. Find the word that could swap places with it. Swift means the same as fast, so swift fits. Slow is its opposite. Asleep and loud describe something else, not speed.
Start with shy. Find the word that could swap places with it. Timid means the same as shy, so timid fits. Bold is its opposite. Lonely and polite describe people, but mean something else.
